summary: Inspect repository state via git and report whether the working tree is clean. Read-only task — no files are created or modified. Reports branch name plus a breakdown of modified, staged, and untracked files based on `git status --porcelain` output.
shortSummary: Report whether the git working tree is clean

steps.description: From /home/matt/moltbot, run `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` to capture the current branch and `git status --porcelain` to enumerate any modifications. Report a single clear conclusion: 'clean' if the porcelain output is empty, otherwise 'not clean' with counts/listing broken down by modified, staged, and untracked entries. Do not edit, stage, commit, push, or delete anything. Do not run `git add`, `git clean`, `git reset`, or any other state-changing git command.
steps.shortSummary: Inspect and report working tree state
steps.successCriteria: Agent reports the current branch and a definitive clean/not-clean verdict based on `git status --porcelain`, with a listing of any untracked/modified/staged files when not clean. No files in the repository have been created, modified, staged, or deleted.
constraints: Do not modify, create, stage, commit, push, or delete any files
Do not run git add, git clean, git reset, git checkout -- , or any other state-changing git command
Do not touch the .git directory directly
